aiStatement: Number of Products: Identifies the count of products reported for a transaction.

facts: Element 62 is numeric, fixed length two digits, zero-padded for single digits, and has valid values 01-10.
Segment 102 and Segment 157 each have a required local Number of Products field preceding repeated product entries.
Segment 143 Element 62 is required and should match the number of products from the Product Code Data Segment (Segment 102).
sourceConclusion.scopeNote: Do not collapse Segment 102 local count, Segment 143 cross-segment count, and Segment 157 local count into one rule merely because they share Element 62.

segment157Composite.scopeNote: Composite chain; draft addresses only its Number of Products component.

aiCaseReview.assessment: All four candidate payloads have Element 62 = 01 in Segment 102 and one observed Product Code entry. Two additionally have Segment 143 Element 62 = 01. No Segment 157 Element 62 is observed. These are bounded producer payload observations; product entry completeness and actual count semantics are not independently validated.

requiredEvidenceForAdjudication: Complete product-entry fixture and independent entry count for Segment 102 and Segment 157 local-count tests.
Paired Segment 102 and Segment 143 response/request fixture proving cross-segment count matching in the applicable context.
Full payload and sidecar semantic review for TC-019781 through TC-019784.
Authorized Test-owner review and execution evidence before any Test chain is promoted.
